disable_tls.description: Use to disable the TLS verification. Defaults to false.

timeout_ms.description: Request Timeout in milliseconds. Defaults to 0, no timeout

client_id.description: Application's Client ID. You can also set it as ENV variable `AUTH0_CLIENT_ID`

client_secret.description: Application's Client Secret. You can also set it as ENV variable `AUTH0_CLIENT_SECRET`

domain.description: Auth0 domain URL in the format `https://<your-tenant-name>.auth0.com`. You can also set it as ENV variable `AUTH0_DOMAIN`

block.description: Auth0 Configuration which is required if you are using `curl2_auth0_token` data

client_id.description: Application ID of an Azure service principal. You can also set it as ENV variable `AZURE_CLIENT_ID`

client_secret.description: Password of the Azure service principal. You can also set it as ENV variable `AZURE_CLIENT_SECRET`

tenant_id.description: ID of the application's Azure AD tenant. You can also set it as ENV variable `AZURE_TENANT_ID`

block.description: Azure AD Configuration which is required if you are using `curl2_azuread_token` data

max_delay_ms.description: The maximum delay between retry requests in milliseconds.

min_delay_ms.description: The minimum delay between retry requests in milliseconds.

retry_attempts.description: The number of times the request is to be retried. For example, if 2 is specified, the request will be tried a maximum of 3 times.

block.description: Retry request configuration. By default there are no retries.
Triggers HTTP(s) requests along with JSON body, authentication as well as custom headers. It also supports token generation from IDP like Azure AD, Auth0.

basic_auth_password.description: Password to be used for Authentication.

basic_auth_username.description: Username to be used for Basic Authentication.

bearer_token.description: Bearer Token to be used for Authentication.

http_method.description: HTTP method like GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, PATCH.

json.description: JSON object in string format if using POST, PUT or PATCH method.

response.description: Valued returned by the HTTP request.

uri.description: URI of resource you'd like to retrieve via HTTP(s).

block.description: Fetches the response for the api

audience.description: The audience for the token, which is your API. Example: "https://xyz.com"

scopes.description: The value passed for the scope parameter in this request should be the resource identifier (application ID URI) of the resource you want, affixed with the .default suffix. Example: ["https://graph.microsoft.com/.default"]
